landscape.narration: This design adds a seventh Odyssey mode so an engineer can record intent, alternatives, and constraints before any code exists, then carry that record through to the pull requests that implement it.

problem_solution.narration: Submit mode already captures intent, but only after the change exists. The alternatives are already closed. Design mode reaches the earlier moment, writes a named design under docs/, and joins N pull requests through an epics array.
problem_solution.problem: The plugin captures author intent at submit time, after the change exists. Nothing captures it at design time, when the engineer still holds the alternatives, the constraints, and the doubts.
problem_solution.solution: A seven-stage /cobuilder-architect:design mode writes docs/architecture/designs/<name>/, drafts a decided ADR, and joins pull requests through design/<name>[/<epic-slug>].

beats.text: Submit mode already interviews an author before the PR opens. That is later than the moment the alternatives are still open. Generate mode then reconstructs intent from merged code.
Name the outcome first. Search existing designs by meaning. Interview five topics. Explore. Challenge until rejected options exist. Draft the ADR. Review. Create the first local branch only.

alternatives.rejected: The interview, bundle, diagrams, and viewer live here.
A design without a corpus degrades into a chat.
A rejected option is an outcome of explore and challenge, not an interview input.
story.json and four readers require a real integer pr.
N epics produce N pull requests.

architecture.narration: Authored source lives in docs/. The bundle is a full rebuild. Architecture modes are self-only. Odyssey keeps --repo. One design lists every ADR it produced, and drift is measured per epic.

beats.text: story.json keys on an integer pr. The plugin ships no agents, hooks, or MCP servers. cobuilder-factory owns epic decomposition.
docs/architecture/designs/<name>/ is the design home. build_adrs.py and build_designs.py rebuild the self bundle only. Submit strips design/ and loads intent.json as the hypothesis.
Design mode does not take --repo, does not push, does not open a PR, and does not decompose epics. A design never enters the timeline until gh pr create returns a number.
